title: Zendikar Rising Commander: card flavor text

entities.name: Heliod
entities.description: A god who, according to The Theriad, placed the sun into the Champion's hand.

entities.name: The Champion
entities.description: A figure from The Theriad who reached for a stone and received the sun from Heliod.

entities.name: The Theriad
entities.description: An in-world writing that tells of the Champion and Heliod.

entities.name: Alovnek
entities.description: A Boros guildmage who wants justice immediately rather than waiting for the arbiters.

entities.name: Boros Legion
entities.description: A guild whose guildmages include Alovnek.

entities.name: Izzet League
entities.description: A guild whose mages build devices such as a thermoinverter.

entities.name: God-Pharaoh
entities.description: A ruler in whose light the people lay prostrate when the gate to the afterlife opened.

entities.name: Kor
entities.description: A people with no concept of exploration who return to forgotten homelands.

entities.name: Oona
entities.description: A faerie figure whose song calls the faeries home so she can feast on the stolen dreams and rumors they bring her.

entities.name: Nephalia
entities.description: A region known for its freezing nights.

entities.name: Marang River
entities.description: A river whose currents wash away tracks and blood.

entities.name: Minosz
entities.description: The Orzhov chief of security, confident no one can get into a fortieth-floor room.

entities.name: Orzhov Syndicate
entities.description: A guild whose chief of security is Minosz.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: A group that found perfection on a plane ruled by Nicol Bolas.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: An elder dragon planeswalker who ruled a plane the Gatewatch visited; he claims birth and death are both reversible.

entities.name: Frogtossers
entities.description: A goblin warren that threads trophies from past raids into their standards to fuel it with the anger of its victims.

entities.name: Kethis
entities.description: Called the Hidden Hand, he declares that every reign must come to an end.

entities.name: Branko One-Ear
entities.description: A speaker who mocks an ogre slumlord's vile tenement.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A necromancer planeswalker who insists that death is no excuse for disobedience.

entities.name: Zulaport
entities.description: A city said to be more dangerous at night than the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Threatening beings compared, unfavorably, to the dangers of Zulaport at night.

entities.name: Tamina
entities.description: A district guide who warns that the shortest path is not always the safest.

entities.name: Vivien Reid
entities.description: A planeswalker who speaks of animals' fundamental connection with their environment.

entities.name: The Roil
entities.description: A phenomenon that redraws the world as it passes, leaving only the hedrons unchanged.

entities.name: Hedrons
entities.description: Objects that remain unchanged when the Roil passes.

entities.name: Chulane
entities.description: The Teller of Tales, who claims only the lion knows more stories than he does.

entities.name: Dosan the Falling Leaf
entities.description: A speaker who says the land grows only where the kami will it.

entities.name: Kami
entities.description: Spirits whose will determines where the land grows.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A planeswalker connected to the plane Zendikar, who came to see Zendikar as magnificent but in pain.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: A plane whose power surges through Nissa; she calls it magnificent but in pain.

entities.name: Gaea
entities.description: An earth deity to whom the coil is said to be an umbilical.

entities.name: Hadi Kasten
entities.description: A naturalist from Calla Dale who observes sporemounds.

entities.name: Calla Dale
entities.description: The home of naturalist Hadi Kasten.

entities.name: Narbulg Nine Fingers
entities.description: A speaker who boasts that taking down a dragon is easy.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: A plane whose ancient places awaken, stirred by Ilharg.

entities.name: Ilharg
entities.description: A being whose hoofbeats stir the ancient places of Ravnica.

entities.name: Nikya of the Old Ways
entities.description: A speaker who proclaims the awakening of Ravnica's ancient places.

entities.name: Greenweaver Mina
entities.description: Twin sister of Denn who, with him, leads the last of the Mul Daya.

entities.name: Denn
entities.description: Twin brother of Mina who, with her, leads the last of the Mul Daya.

entities.name: Mul Daya
entities.description: A people whose last members are led by Mina and Denn into an uncertain future.

entities.name: Magic Mirror
entities.description: An artifact that crystallized a mere drop of water into much more.

entities.name: Blackblade
entities.description: A blade that spilled the blood of one elder dragon and may taste another's in Gideon's hands.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker in whose hands the Blackblade may yet taste another elder dragon's blood.

entities.name: House Dimir
entities.description: A secret guild whose insignia is seen only by its own members and the doomed.

entities.name: Ivrelya
entities.description: A Dimir spymaster who offers a locket to those taking their place among the shadows.

entities.name: Jhoira
entities.description: A master artificer who calls mana possibility not yet given form.

entities.name: Duskmantle
entities.description: A place in the undercity from which misinformation spreads.

entities.name: Naya
entities.description: A land of behemoths where ambition and treachery are scarce due to awe of terrestrial gods.

entities.name: Selesnya Conclave
entities.description: A guild that stands united, open to one and all.

entities.name: Kiora
entities.description: A planeswalker who says mysteries will remain in the depths of the sea.

events.summary: In the myth recounted in The Theriad, the Champion reached for a stone and Heliod placed the sun into her hand.
events.quote: The Champion reached for a stone, and Heliod placed the sun into her hand.

events.summary: The gate to the afterlife opened and the people lay prostrate in the light of the God-Pharaoh.
events.quote: In the first moments, the gate to the afterlife opened, and the people were prostrate in the light of the God-Pharaoh.

events.summary: The Gatewatch found perfection on a plane ruled by Nicol Bolas, which they did not expect.
events.quote: The one thing the Gatewatch didn't expect to find on a plane ruled by Nicol Bolas was perfection.

events.summary: Nissa's connection to Zendikar is restored and she feels its power surge through her.
events.quote: Her connection to the plane restored, Nissa felt the power of Zendikar surge through her.

events.summary: Nissa realizes Zendikar is not evil or vengeful but in pain.
events.quote: It's not evil or vengeful. It's magnificent . . . but it's in pain.

events.summary: The ancient places of Ravnica awaken, stirred by Ilharg's hoofbeats.
events.quote: The ancient places of Ravnica awaken, stirred by the hoofbeats of Ilharg!

events.summary: Mina and Denn lead the last of the Mul Daya into an uncertain future.
events.quote: Greenweaver Mina and her twin brother Denn lead the last of the Mul Daya into an uncertain future.

events.summary: The Blackblade, having spilled one elder dragon's blood, is now in Gideon's hands.
events.quote: It spilled the blood of one elder dragon. In Gideon's hands, it may yet taste another's.
